CVE-2007-1218.title: Off-by-one buffer overflow in the parse_elements function in the  ...
CVE-2007-1218.description: Off-by-one buffer overflow in the parse_elements function in the 802.11 printer code (print-802_11.c) for tcpdump 3.9.5 and earlier allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (crash) via a crafted 802.11 frame.  NOTE: this was originally referred to as heap-based, but it might be stack-based.

CVE-2007-3798.title: Integer overflow in print-bgp.c in the BGP dissector in tcpdump 3 ...
CVE-2007-3798.description: Integer overflow in print-bgp.c in the BGP dissector in tcpdump 3.9.6 and earlier allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted TLVs in a BGP packet, related to an unchecked return value.
